title: MRI brain prior authorization
content: MRI brain with contrast requires prior authorization and documentation supporting neurologic medical necessity.

title: A1c diabetes diagnosis support
content: Hemoglobin A1c is supported when billed with a synthetic diabetes diagnosis code and frequency is documented.

title: Lipid screening eligibility check
content: Preventive lipid screening requires active coverage on the date of service.

title: Physical therapy progress note
content: Therapeutic exercise is compatible with low back pain when progress notes support ongoing functional improvement.

title: Advanced imaging authorization
content: Advanced MRI imaging requires prior authorization and diagnosis-to-procedure support before submission.

title: DME mobility aid authorization
content: Crutches require mobility limitation documentation and prior authorization when billed through a DME supplier.

title: Stress test diagnosis support
content: Cardiovascular stress testing is supported for angina when ordering documentation is attached.

title: Preventive visit clean path
content: Annual preventive medicine visit with general adult exam diagnosis follows a clean validation path under active coverage.

title: Outpatient imaging place of service
content: Outpatient hospital MRI claims should include facility documentation and authorization reference.

title: Therapy treatment documentation
content: Therapeutic exercise should include time-based documentation and a signed plan of care.

title: DME supplier credential check
content: DME claims require synthetic supplier credential status and item delivery confirmation.

title: Cardiology active eligibility
content: Cardiology stress testing requires active member eligibility and ordering provider documentation.
